correctness.rationale: Inspected RESULT.md and CHECK.py; reconstructed the 2m-cycle hat Gram matrix G_jj=(a+b)/3 and G_j,j+1=h_j/6, its sign-gauged positive inverse, and the recurrence H u_k-ab(u_(k-1)+u_(k+1))=12(a+b)delta_k0. The unique cyclic Green row U_k=(12s/Delta)(q^k+q^(m-k))/(1-q^m), V_k=(aU_k+bU_(k+1))/(2s) is the periodization of the decaying recurrence with q=(H-Delta)/(2ab). Exact absolute integral of a signed linear segment equals h(u²+v²)/(2(u+v)), giving the asserted finite formula. Strict convexity/strict triangle inequality excludes interior evaluation points because adjacent kernel rows cross signs; reproduction of 1 yields defect -(Lambda_m-1)/2. Independent exact rational Gram inversions and norm sums agreed for m=2,3,4,5,6 and a:b=1:1,1:2,2:5,7:3 (20 cases); the limit follows from geometric tail bounds and reduces to 2-(a-b)²/((3a+b)(a+3b)). Tests support, but do not replace, the cyclic recurrence proof.
